name: Refugee Status Determination

requirements.blocker_text: Cameroon has a domestic refugee law -- Law No. 2005/006 on refugee status -- with an implementing decree (Décret No. 2011/389) establishing the organization and functioning of the bodies managing refugee status. Cameroon is also party to the 1951 Refugee Convention, its 1967 Protocol, the 1969 OAU Refugee Convention, and the Kampala Convention on internal displacement. This dataset could only confirm the existence and citation of Law 2005/006 and its implementing decree -- the full text (refugee definition used, the administering commission's exact structure, and the specific rights granted for work, movement, and family unity) could not be read directly in this build, since Refworld's page for this law returned only metadata/navigation content rather than the substantive articles.
requirements.fix_path: File a refugee status claim under Law 2005/006's determination process; this dataset could not confirm the exact registration steps or deadlines.

outcome.duration_length: indefinite, tied to continued protection needs
